column3: Turns the questions into a prohibition; “the time is right” replaces love’s own wish.
“Conceived you” replaces being in labor with you in the first statement about the mother.
“The fiercest blaze of all” interprets the phrase “a flame of Yah.”
“His offer” makes the offer, rather than the man, the object of scorn.
“Not yet grown” explains the absence of breasts as undeveloped breasts.
“To protect her” adds a purpose; “panels” pluralizes the board.
“Leased” specifies how the vineyard was given, and “shekels” specifies the unit of silver.
“Mine to give” replaces being before me, and “shekels” specifies the unit.
“Come away” renders the command to flee as departure.
